title: Robust Dual-Signal Fusion: Hybrid Neuro-Symbolic Gating with Compressed Chain-of-Thought Refinement for Irony Detection in Social Media Texts
abstract: arXiv:2606.16845v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Small-scale Large Language Models (LLMs) natively default to literal semantic interpretations, making few-shot irony detection a persistent challenge in noisy, user-generated text. In this study, we show that, despite this limitation, inference from compact LLMs can still be effectively harnessed for this task. We introduce the Robust Dual-Signal (RDS) Fusion framework, a hybrid neuro-symbolic architecture that utilizes a compressed Chain-of-Thought (CoT) of an LLM, alongside a static, pretrained RoBERTa and a symbolic prior module in two downstream fusions. RDS Fusion demonstrates better performance than an unrestricted reasoning ablation, while requiring substantially lower inference time. We also find that in our experiments, unrestricted reasoning does not yield better results than restricted reasoning. Evaluated on a strictly held-out TweetEval test set ($N=734$), RDS Fusion achieves $78.1\%$ accuracy and a Macro F1 of $0.

translated_title: 鲁棒双信号融合：基于混合神经-符号门控与压缩思维链精炼的社交媒体文本反讽检测方法
translated_abstract: 小规模大语言模型（LLM）天然倾向于字面语义解读，这使得在嘈杂的用户生成文本中进行少样本反讽检测成为一个持续的难题。在本研究中，我们表明，尽管存在这一局限，紧凑型LLM的推理能力仍然可以被有效利用于该任务。我们提出了鲁棒双信号（RDS）融合框架，这是一种混合神经-符号架构，它利用LLM的压缩思维链（CoT），并结合静态的预训练RoBERTa模型与符号先验模块，进行两种下游融合。RDS融合框架展现出优于无约束推理消融版本的性能，同时所需的推理时间显著更低。我们还在实验中发现，无约束推理并未带来优于受约束推理的结果。在严格隔离的TweetEval测试集（N=734）上进行评估，RDS融合框架达到了78.1%的准确率和0...的宏F1分数。
tldr: 提出鲁棒双信号（RDS）融合框架，通过混合神经-符号门控将压缩思维链、预训练RoBERTa与符号先验模块进行融合，在少样本社交媒体反讽检测任务上以显著更低的推理时间超越了无约束推理的性能。
en_tdlr: We propose the Robust Dual-Signal (RDS) Fusion framework, a hybrid neuro-symbolic architecture that fuses compressed Chain-of-Thought reasoning, a pretrained RoBERTa, and symbolic priors, achieving better few-shot irony detection performance than unrestricted reasoning while requiring substantially lower inference time.
